## 2. TechServices Password Reset Link

⚠️ **Important security note:** I found two emails related to this, and one of them looks suspicious.

- **Legitimate email** — from `support@techservices.com` (subject: "TechServices Password Reset Request"):
  https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

- **Suspicious/phishing email** — from `tech-services-password@aol.com` (subject: "Your TechServices password reset request"). This one claims to be from an "alternative address" of Tech Services and contains a link to `password-reset-12bh12.com`, which is **not** a techservices.com domain. This is a classic phishing attempt — **do not click that link**.

I recommend using only the link from the official `support@techservices.com` email:
**https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei**
